name: Overlook
description: Your bookmarks in folders, Spotlight-style search and sharp site icons over a photo of your choice.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' https: http:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; require-trusted-types-for 'script'; trusted-types 'none'
